description: Headless facade that fronts the Peripherals tool of NXP S32 Configuration Tools via `nxp_s32ct_execute_action(action_name="s32ct.configure_peripherals", params={...})`. Triggers when users ask to import existing `.c` peripheral files (`-ImportC`), import a toolchain project (`-importProject`), point to an SDK manifest (`-sdkPath`), overwrite with SDK sources (`-overwriteWithSdkSources`), migrate components to a specific toolchain version or the highest available version, apply `custom_copyright` / `output_path_overrides`, and regenerate source / HTML / MEX from a `.mex` project. Delegates shared launcher plumbing (workspace `-data`, `s32ct_launcher`, `launcher_ini`, `timeout_s`, retry-on-`IllegalStateException`) to `s32ct-cli`. Keywords: peripherals, ImportC, importProject, sdkPath, migrate components, ExportSrc, ExportHTML, ExportMEX, `.mex`, `.c`.
